 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.231/2025 registered at Police Station - Mangawa, District Rewa (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(n),
506 of the IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
The applicant is in custody since 18.05.2025.

2. Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that the victim was a consenting party and the physical relations were established with her consent and when the victim got the pregnancy, the Panchayat organized, but the matter could not be solved.
Hence, victim has lodged the FIR and applicant has been arrested.
Trial of the case will take time to be concluded.
Hence, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50049 2 MCRC-44886-2025 3.

Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and has submitted that the victim was the minor when the firstly relationship was established and the last three years the applicant was exploiting and sexually assaulting the victim, as a result the victim has got the pregnancy.
No case for bail is made out.
Hence, the applicant could not be released on bail.

4. Heard the learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Looking to the factual aspects and the age at present and looking to the fact that trial will take time to be concluded, this Court deems it appropriate to release the applicant on bail, therefore,

6. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
8. Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
C.C. as per rules.
